summary: Konami's run-and-gun action series, covering the arcade/NES originals, 16-bit entries, 3D experiments, handheld revival, and modern reimaginings.

entries.title: Contra

primary.why: The Anniversary Collection includes arcade, NES, and Famicom versions on PC and modern consoles, making it the most complete current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Contra through Contra Anniversary Collection on Windows/Steam.

secondary.exclusive_content: Distinct Japan-only MSX2 version with flip-screen structure.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the MSX2 version only for its distinct structure.
secondary.why: The MSX2 game differs substantially from the arcade/NES versions and is not included in the main collection route.

all_releases.platform: Arcade / NES / Famicom / home computers / MSX2
all_releases.fidelity: Original arcade/NES/computer releases and distinct MSX2 route.
all_releases.reason: secondary: MSX2 is distinct; arcade/NES/Famicom are covered by Anniversary Collection.

all_releases.platform: Windows / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / Nintendo Switch
all_releases.reason: primary: current complete route for the classic versions.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Anniversary Collection covers the main arcade/NES/Famicom routes, but MSX2 is a distinct secondary version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Operation Galuga is a later reimagining and is tracked separately.

primary.why: Legacy of War is a 32-bit 3D Contra entry with PlayStation and Saturn releases; use the best available original-platform route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation version with DuckStation or the Saturn version with Mednafen/SSF.

primary.why: C: The Contra Adventure is a PlayStation-only 3D entry; PlayStation hardware or emulation is the route.
primary.how_to_play: Play C: The Contra Adventure with DuckStation.

primary.why: Shattered Soldier is a PS2 return to 2D run-and-gun structure; PCSX2 gives it the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Contra: Shattered Soldier with PCSX2 at increased internal resolution.

primary.why: Neo Contra is a PS2-only top-down Contra entry; PCSX2 gives it the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Neo Contra with PCSX2 at increased internal resolution.

entries.title: Contra 4

primary.why: Contra 4 is a DS entry built around dual-screen play; DS hardware or emulation is the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Contra 4 on Nintendo DS hardware or melonDS/DeSmuME with a vertical dual-screen layout.

all_releases.platform: Nintendo DS / mobile phone / Windows Mobile / Android
all_releases.fidelity: Original DS release plus mobile adaptations.
all_releases.reason: primary: DS is the intended full route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile Redux versions are adaptations, not the preferred full route.

primary.why: Hard Corps: Uprising is a digital PS3/Xbox 360 spiritual/prequel entry with no modern port identified.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3/Xbox 360 hardware if already owned, or compatible preservation setup.
